thread:
Priya: quick q — proposing we shift the daily triage a bit for better APAC overlap. Suggest M/F 18:30 UTC, Wed keep at 19:00 UTC (infra sync conflict). Agenda sketch: 1) open P0/P1s (5m), 2) handoffs + recent deploys (5m), 3) paging & owners (5m), 4) post-rollout watchlist (5m). Trial for 2 weeks? :clock8:
Sam: prefer 18:30 on Mon/Fri. Wed at 19:00 works for me. Wed conflict is infra meeting for me too unless we move infra.
Jordan: I can cover Wed this cycle if that helps. Agree on agenda. Can we add a 2‑min "known flakiness" check for any flaky jobs?
Miguel: +1 for the shift. I'll add a pager-owner table to the agenda doc so it's clear who gets pages when.
Oncall Bot: INCIDENT SUMMARY: 3 open alerts — RUM-502 (P1), kvcache-evict (P2), scheduler-lag (P1). Details: https://incidents.redwood.internal/INC-2026-23
Priya: sounds good. Decision: M/F 18:30 UTC, Wed stay 19:00 — trial 2 weeks. @Jordan can you create the calendar invites and attach the agenda doc? I'll update rotation notes and escalation list.
Sam: noted. Also FYI I'm OOO next Thu so please assign me out-of-rotation that week; will swap with Miguel if needed.
Jordan: creating invites & agenda now. Sending calendar links... Agenda doc: https://docs.redwood.com/eng/oncall/shift-agenda — please add items directly.
Miguel: added pager table + handover checklist (logs, recent deploys, config changes) to the agenda doc. Left a sample entry for who to page for DB vs. runtime issues.
Priya: thanks — one more thing: let's reserve a 5‑min "post-mortem watchlist" slot to highlight any recent rollouts we should watch for regressions.
Sam: yes please. makes follow-ups simpler. :thumbsup:
Jordan: calendar invites sent for next 2 weeks (Mon/Fri 18:30 UTC, Wed 19:00 UTC). CC @Oncall Bot to post daily digest ahead of triage.
Oncall Bot: NEXT STEPS: created triage events; daily incident digest scheduled for 18:15 UTC (Mon/Wed/Fri). Will post reminder & current open list 15m before each triage.
Priya: perfect — thanks everyone. If nothing else, we start the new window Monday. Add anything urgent to the agenda doc and I'll nudge owners before the call.
file_notes: short thread about shifting triage times, agenda, and calendar invites; includes bot incident summary and links
